cycles.programme: Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board Group D common recruitment
cycles.statusNote: Signed 17 September corrigendum extends new applications and fee payment to 21 September. Correction portal 2026-09-24–2026-09-27 at 17:00 IST is for existing applicants only; it does not reopen recruitment. Older HTML date row is superseded. Founder review pending.
cycles.scopeLabel: Punjab government departments; department and post rows are positions within one application cycle, not separate cycles or examination venues
cycles.outcome: 2,098 Group D positions across Punjab government departments, including Sewadar, Chowkidar and Safai Sewak roles, subject to category and department allocation
cycles.qualifications: Original notice generally requires Matriculation with Punjabi as a subject. It names education exceptions for blind and riot/terror affected persons and sweeper appointments. Role-specific qualification and exception evidence need founder review.
cycles.citizenshipRule: Notice does not state whether foreign citizens may apply, enter the test, or receive a Punjab government appointment. International applicants must confirm each stage directly with PSSSB.
cycles.residenceRule: Original notice's reservation section says every category must present a Punjab domicile/residence certificate issued within five years at counselling. Scope for unreserved and international applicants needs authority confirmation; do not infer that foreign residence alone determines eligibility.
selectionStages: Part A Matric-equivalent Punjabi qualifying test, minimum 50%
Part B scored objective examination with negative marking
Common merit list, document verification and counselling
Recommendation to hiring department and appointment checks
cycles.fee: Original notice: ₹1,000 general/freedom-fighter/sports; ₹250 SC/BC/EWS; ₹200 ex-servicemen/dependents; ₹500 persons with disabilities. Fee paid once is non-refundable. Correction may require category fee difference.

age.evidence: Original advertisement page 4: minimum 18 on 1 January 2026. General maximum 37 and several category/employee/disability/widow/ex-service exceptions require individual verification.

languages.requirement: Mandatory Punjabi qualifying test equivalent to Matriculation standard; at least 50% required for final merit. Matric Punjabi subject is general educational requirement with stated role/person exceptions. No CEFR level.
languages.evidence: Original advertisement pages 3–5, quoted service rule and examination scheme.

manualChecks.text: Confirm whether PSSSB accepts foreign citizens and whether this post's education, Punjabi-subject and age exception rules apply to you; notice gives no international route.

Verify Punjabi Part A score of at least 50%, role-specific qualification and current Punjab domicile/residence certificate required at counselling according to original notice. Authority must clarify how this applies to unreserved and international applicants.
Confirm foreign-citizen Punjab government appointment permission and all department/category document checks with PSSSB.

venues.name: Examination venue not published in the reviewed notices

changes.summary: Board reopened application and revised vacancy count; original advertisement remains same cycle.
Signed corrigendum raised total to 2,098 and extended application/fee deadline to 21 September.
Existing applicants may correct specified form fields through 27 September at 17:00 IST; new applications remain closed.

cycles.title: Punjab Group D government recruitment 2026

applicationWindow.note: Original window was 27 February–20 March 2026; reopened 25 August. Signed 17 September corrigendum gives final 21 September application and fee deadline without a cutoff time. Correction window through 27 September at 17:00 is only for previously submitted forms.

cycles.salary: Original notice lists Group D Level 1 pay scale ₹18,000–₹56,900 under 7th CPC; actual appointment terms vary by role and department.

sources.title: 17 September final vacancy and deadline corrigendum

warnings: Only Group D advertisement 04/2026 extracted; PSSSB other groups, departments and future notices remain gaps.

Original Punjabi notice and later signed amendments override older vacancy-detail HTML date. Latest signed notice closes new applications on 21 September, despite correction portal through 27 September.

International applicant/appointment permission is unstated. Punjab domicile certificate wording is in reservation section but refers to every category; founder must confirm implications before publication.
No official cutoff hour is printed for new applications on 21 September. The 17:00 time applies only to the correction portal.

Critical deadline and vacancy fields depend on pinned signed PDF https://sssb.punjab.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/12345698_merged.pdf; correction status depends on https://sssb.punjab.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Regarding-Correction-Portal-of-Advt.-no.-04-of-2026-Group-D.pdf. Any byte change withholds extraction.
